title: State Museums File
description: A state-level museum data file for the MuseumSpark dataset

museum_id.description: Stable identifier (slug or UUID). Recommended: slug-based for readability.

last_updated.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last record update

address_last_verified.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last address verification

museum_type.description: Primary museum classification (locked set per MRD Section 7)

primary_focus.description: Concise classification phrase: neutral, factual, sortable (per MRD Section 8)

topics.description: Topics or subject areas (e.g., Impressionism, Native American, Modern)

reputation_level.description: Structural scope of institutional recognition (MRD v3.1.T Section 4, field 14). International/National=penalty+0; Regional=+2; Supra-Local=+3; Local=+4

reputation.description: DEPRECATED: Use reputation_level (string). Legacy integer mapping: 0=International, 1=National, 2=Regional, 3=Supra-Local, 4=Local

collection_level.description: Scale and structural role of permanent holdings (MRD v3.1.T Section 4, field 15). Flagship/Strong=penalty+0; Moderate=+2; Small=+4

collection_tier.description: DEPRECATED: Use collection_level (string). Legacy integer mapping: 0=Flagship, 1=Strong, 2=Moderate, 3=Small

time_needed.description: Estimated visit duration. Quick stop ~1-1.25hr; Half day ~2.5-3hr; Most of the Day ~4-5hr; All Day ~6-7hr

estimated_visit_minutes.description: More precise visit time in minutes

nearby_museum_count.description: Number of other museums in the same city

city_region.description: Multi-city region (e.g., Bay Area, DFW, New England)

visit_priority_notes.description: Travel-specific notes separate from collection notes

data_sources.description: URLs or source tags for data provenance

confidence.description: Overall confidence in this record's accuracy (1-5)

created_at.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of record creation

updated_at.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last record update

modern_contemporary_strength.description: Modern/Contemporary collection strength (same 0-5 scale as impressionist_strength)

hat_strength.description: Historical Art Traditions strength (0-5). Art grounded in sustained cultural/workshop/lineage traditions. Does not include works defined by modernist rupture. Added v3.1.T

primary_art.description: Primary art period focus (derived as strongest of the three collection axes)

historical_context_score.description: Quality and depth of historical interpretation (0=None, 1=Minimal, 2=Descriptive/Local, 3=Intentional Framing, 4=Deep Integrated, 5=Canon-Defining). Score 5 = Must-See qualifier.

eca_score.description: Exhibitions & Curatorial Authority (0=None, 1=Minimal, 2=Competent, 3=Strong Regional, 4=Nationally Recognized, 5=Field-Shaping). Evaluates programmatic authority only, not permanent holdings.

collection_based_strength.description: Overall depth/authority across all art categories (0=None, 1=Limited, 2=Modest, 3=Strong Regional, 4=Major Scholarly, 5=Canon-Defining)

collection_based_pas.description: Collection-Based Primary Art Strength: MAX(impressionist_strength, modern_contemporary_strength, hat_strength). Computed field. Added v3.1.T

effective_pas.description: Effective Primary Art Strength: MAX(collection_based_pas, eca_score). ECA may elevate but does not sum. Used in Priority Score formula. Added v3.1.T

priority_score.description: Computed priority ranking (lower = higher priority). Floor of 1. Formula: MAX(1, (6-effective_pas)*2 + (6-historical_context_score) + reputation_penalty + collection_penalty + dual_strength_bonus)

outcome_tier.description: Behavioral routing tier reflecting predicted visitor travel gravity. Deterministically assigned per MRD Section 6. Added v3.1.T

additional_labels.description: Subtype label for Detour and Consider tiers (e.g., Specialized Art Site, Locally Historic, Quirky / Memorable, Kunsthalle, Generalized Collection Museum, You Won't See This Again, Specialized Cultural Site). Required when outcome_tier is Detour or Consider. Added v3.1.T

audit_tracker.description: Provenance of most recent audit: Version | Date | Outcome (CH=Changed, NC=No Change). Example: 'v3.1.T | 2026-03-01 | NC'. Informational only. Added v3.1.T

is_scored.description: Whether this museum has been scored (for filtering art vs non-art museums)

is_scoreable.description: Whether this museum is eligible for scoring (art museums only)

scoring_version.description: Version of scoring algorithm used (e.g., v3.1.T)

score_last_verified.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of last score verification

notes.description: Public-facing notes (factual, neutral, 2-4 sentences per MRD Section 8 writing standards)
